units.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held
units.text: 3) at the request of bodies or officials authorized by federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held
units.text: 2. The employer's representative may suspend a civil servant from the position held (not permit performance of official duties) for the period of:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held
units.text: 1) resolution of a conflict of interest;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held
units.text: 2) verification of:
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held
units.text: а) the accuracy and completeness of information on income, expenditure, property and property-related obligations submitted by the civil servant under Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’ and other federal laws;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held
units.text: б) information submitted by the civil servant upon entry into the civil service under normative legal acts of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held
units.text: в) the civil servant's compliance with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest and performance of duties established by Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’ and other federal laws;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 2 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held
units.text: 3) an internal service inquiry under Article 59 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held
units.text: 2.1. Repealed. — Federal Law No. 418-ФЗ of 02.12.2019.
units.label: Part 2.1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held
units.text: 3. The employer's representative suspends the civil servant from the position held (does not permit performance of official duties) for the entire period until the circumstances forming the grounds for suspension (non-admission to official duties) are eliminated.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held
units.text: 4. During suspension from the civil service position held (non-admission to official duties) on any ground in part 1 of this Article, monetary remuneration is not retained, except in cases provided for by other federal laws. During suspension (non-admission to official duties) on any ground in part 2 of this Article, monetary remuneration for the position held is retained throughout the suspension.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 32

units.locator: Chapter 6. GROUNDS AND CONSEQUENCES OF TERMINATION OF A SERVICE CONTRACT
units.text: Chapter 6. GROUNDS AND CONSEQUENCES OF TERMINATION OF A SERVICE CONTRACT
units.label: Chapter 6. GROUNDS AND CONSEQUENCES OF TERMINATION OF A SERVICE CONTRACT

units.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service
units.text: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service
units.label: Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service
units.text: 1. The general grounds for termination of a service contract, release from the civil service position held and dismissal from the civil service are:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service
units.text: 1) agreement of the parties to the service contract (Article 34 of this Federal Law);
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service
units.text: 2) expiry of a fixed-term service contract (Article 35 of this Federal Law);
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service
units.text: 3) termination on the civil servant's initiative (Article 36 of this Federal Law);
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service
units.text: 4) termination on the employer's representative's initiative (part 7 of Article 27 and Article 37 of this Federal Law);
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service
units.text: 5) transfer of the civil servant, at their request or with their consent, to another type of state service;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service
units.text: 6) repealed. — Federal Law No. 57-ФЗ of 05.04.2013;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service
units.text: 7) refusal to continue state service relations in the current position or to accept another position offered in the cases provided for by Article 29 of this Federal Law, because changes in professional service conditions entail changes to the service contract;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service
units.text: 8) refusal to transfer to another civil service position, with reasons for refusal stated, or absence of such a position in the state body, as provided for by part 10 of Article 28 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service
units.text: 9) refusal to transfer to another locality together with the state body;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service
units.text: 10) circumstances beyond the control of the parties to the service contract (Article 39 of this Federal Law);
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service
units.text: 11) breach of mandatory rules for concluding a service contract established by this Federal Law or other federal laws, if the breach precludes holding the civil service position (Article 40 of this Federal Law);
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service
units.text: 12) termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation or possession of foreign citizenship (nationality), a residence permit or another document confirming the citizen's right to permanent residence in a foreign State (Article 41 of this Federal Law);
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service
units.text: 13) failure to comply with restrictions or fulfil obligations established by this Federal Law and other federal laws;
units.label: Point 13 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service
units.text: 14) violation of civil-service-related prohibitions provided for by Article 17 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 14 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service
units.text: 15) repealed. — Federal Law No. 509-ФЗ of 31.12.2014.
units.label: Point 15 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service
units.text: 1.1. A general ground for termination of a service contract and release from the position held is transfer of the civil servant, at their request or with their consent, to another civil service position in another state body in the cases provided for by part 6 of Article 28 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service
units.text: 2. Termination of a service contract, release from the civil service position held and dismissal from the civil service are formalized by a legal act of the state body.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service
units.text: 3. On the final day of the civil servant's performance of official duties, the employer's representative must issue the work record book or provide employment history information for the period of civil service in that state body and make the final settlement. On the civil servant's written application, the employer's representative must also issue other documents relating to civil service and pension provision.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service
units.text: 4. Employment history information is provided by the method specified in the civil servant's application: duly certified on paper, or as an electronic document signed with an enhanced qualified electronic signature if the employer's representative has one. The civil servant submits the application in writing or sends it to the employer's representative's email address in the manner established by that representative.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. General grounds for terminating a service contract, release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service
units.text: 5. On the day of release from the civil service position and/or dismissal from the civil service, the civil servant must surrender the official service identity card to the state body's subdivision responsible for state service and personnel.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 34. Termination of a service contract by agreement of the parties
units.text: Article 34. Termination of a service contract by agreement of the parties
units.label: Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Termination of a service contract by agreement of the parties
units.text: A service contract may be terminated at any time by agreement of its parties, with simultaneous release of the civil servant from the position held and dismissal from the civil service.
units.label: Art. 34 · text

units.locator: Article 35. Termination of a fixed-term service contract
units.text: Article 35. Termination of a fixed-term service contract
units.label: Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Termination of a fixed-term service contract
units.text: 1. A fixed-term service contract is terminated upon expiry. Unless otherwise established by this Federal Law, the civil servant must be notified in writing at least seven days before release from the position held and dismissal from the civil service.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Termination of a fixed-term service contract
units.text: 2. A fixed-term service contract concluded for the performance of a specified assignment is terminated upon completion of that assignment, and the civil servant is released from the position held and dismissed from the civil service.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Termination of a fixed-term service contract
units.text: 3. A fixed-term service contract concluded to replace an absent civil servant whose position is retained under this Federal Law is terminated when that civil servant returns to service; the replacement is released from the position and dismissed from the civil service.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Termination of a fixed-term service contract
units.text: 4. Upon expiry of the prescribed term of office of a civil servant holding a position in the ‘managers’ or ‘assistants (advisers)’ category, the civil servant may be appointed to the position previously held or another civil service position, except where the civil servant has committed culpable acts, if such a condition is provided for by the fixed-term service contract.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Termination of a fixed-term service contract
units.text: 5. When a fixed-term service contract for a position held through rotation is terminated, and the civil servant is released from the position and dismissed in the cases specified in part 9 of Article 60.1 of this Federal Law, compensation equal to four months' monetary remuneration is paid. No severance allowance is paid in addition.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 36. Termination of a service contract on the civil servant's initiative
units.text: Article 36. Termination of a service contract on the civil servant's initiative
units.label: Art. 36

units.locator: Article 36. Termination of a service contract on the civil servant's initiative
units.text: 1. A civil servant may terminate the service contract and leave the civil service on their own initiative by giving the employer's representative two weeks' written notice.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 36

units.locator: Article 36. Termination of a service contract on the civil servant's initiative
units.text: 2. Where the civil servant's application to terminate the service contract and leave the civil service on their own initiative is due to inability to continue official duties and civil service (enrolment in an organization conducting educational activities, retirement, taking up an elected office or other circumstances), or where the employer's representative has been found to have violated laws, other normative legal acts or the service contract, the employer's representative must terminate the contract on the date specified in the civil servant's application.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 36

units.locator: Article 36. Termination of a service contract on the civil servant's initiative
units.text: 3. Before the notice period for termination and departure expires, the civil servant may withdraw the application at any time. Release from the position and dismissal do not take place unless another civil servant or citizen has been invited to take that position.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 36

units.locator: Article 36. Termination of a service contract on the civil servant's initiative
units.text: 4. After the notice period for termination of the service contract and departure from the civil service expires, the civil servant may cease performing official duties.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 36

units.locator: Article 36. Termination of a service contract on the civil servant's initiative
units.text: 5. Repealed. — Federal Law No. 87-ФЗ of 22.04.2024.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 36

units.locator: Article 36. Termination of a service contract on the civil servant's initiative
units.text: 6. Upon termination of the service contract and dismissal, the civil servant is removed from the state body's register of civil servants, and their personnel file is deposited in the state body's archive in the prescribed manner.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 36

units.locator: Article 36. Termination of a service contract on the civil servant's initiative
units.text: 7. By agreement between the civil servant and the employer's representative, the civil servant may be released from the position and dismissed before the period specified in this Article expires.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 36

units.locator: Article 36. Termination of a service contract on the civil servant's initiative
units.text: 8. On the civil servant's written application, release from the position and dismissal take place after annual paid leave has been granted or after the period of temporary incapacity for work ends.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 36

units.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.text: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.label: Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.text: 1. The employer's representative may terminate the service contract, release the civil servant from the position held and dismiss them from the civil service in the event of:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.text: 1) the civil servant's unsuitability for the position held:
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.text: а) on health grounds in accordance with a medical report;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.text: б) owing to an insufficient professional level confirmed by the results of attestation;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.text: 1.1) loss of the employer's representative's confidence in the civil servant in cases of non-compliance with restrictions and prohibitions, requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and failure to perform duties established for the purpose of combating corruption by this Federal Law, Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’ and other federal laws;
units.label: Point 1.1 Part 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.text: 2) repeated failure by a civil servant to perform official duties without valid reasons, if the civil servant has a disciplinary sanction;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.text: 3) a single gross breach of official duties by a civil servant:
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.text: а) absenteeism (absence from the place of civil service without valid reasons for more than four consecutive hours during a service day);
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 3 Part 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.text: б) reporting for service in a state of intoxication by alcohol, narcotics or other toxic substances;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 3 Part 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.text: в) disclosure of information constituting a state secret or another secret protected by federal law, and of official information, which became known to the civil servant in connection with the performance of official duties;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 3 Part 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.text: г) theft (including petty theft) of another person's property, misappropriation, or intentional destruction of or damage to such property at the place of civil service, established by a court judgment that has entered into legal force or a resolution of a body authorized to consider cases of administrative offences;
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 3 Part 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.text: д) breach by a civil servant of the requirements for protection of professional service activities (occupational safety), if that breach caused grave consequences (an accident in service, a major accident or a disaster) or knowingly created a real threat of such consequences;
units.label: Subpoint «д» Point 3 Part 1 Art. 37
